en.headline: Coleman Wong falls to Arthur Gea in Los Cabos semi-final
en.dek: The Hong Kong player lost 7-6, 6-3 to the French qualifier, ending his run at the ATP 250 event after reaching his first Tour semi-final and securing a top-100 ranking.
body: Hong Kong's Coleman Wong was defeated 7-6 (7), 6-3 by France's Arthur Gea in the semi-finals of the Los Cabos Open on Saturday, ending his campaign at the ATP 250 tournament.

Wong, 22, had reached his first ATP Tour semi-final earlier in the week by upsetting higher-ranked opponents, including world No. 12 Jiri Lehecka. The result still ensures he will enter the world's top 100 for the first time when the new rankings are published on Monday.
Gea, ranked 127, advanced to his first ATP final and will face Denis Shapovalov. Wong's breakthrough week marks a significant step for Hong Kong tennis.

zh.headline: 黃澤林洛斯卡沃斯半決賽不敵法國新秀 止步四強
zh.dek: 港將直落兩盤輸給法國球員吉亞，結束ATP 250賽事征途；惟仍穩奪生涯首次入圍世界排名前100。
body: 香港網球手黃澤林星期六在洛斯卡沃斯公開賽半決賽以6-7（7）、3-6不敵法國球員阿蒂爾·吉亞，無緣決賽。
22歲的黃澤林本周先後擊敗包括世界排名第12的列赫卡等對手，首次打入ATP巡迴賽四強。雖然半決賽落敗，但排名積分已足夠保證他在星期一公布的新排名榜首次躋身世界前100。
吉亞將與沙波華洛夫爭奪冠軍。黃澤林今次突破被視為香港網球重要一步。
